title: The Story of a Tinder-box
author: Charles Meymott Tidy

authorInfo.bio: Charles Meymott Tidy (1843–1892) was an English medical man and sanitary chemist, a barrister who wrote also on legal matters.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Story of a Tinder-box" by Charles Meymott Tidy is a collection of scientific lectures designed for a juvenile audience, written during the late 19th century. The book explores the history and methods of producing fire, from ancient techniques to the advent of modern matches.
